agentInjectDefaultTemplate.description: Default template type for secret injection

agentInjectUseLeaderElector.description: Enable leader election for agent injector

agentInjectVaultAddr.description: Vault address for agent injection. If empty, will be auto-configured

agentInjectVaultImage.description: Vault image for agent sidecar. If empty, will use default

externalIP.description: External IP address for secret-store-service endpoints

namespace.description: Namespace where Vault Injector will be deployed

nsLimitRange.description: Namespace-level LimitRange configuration for default container resource limits

defaultLimits.description: Default resource limits applied to all containers in the namespace. Set to null to omit limits from the LimitRange.

cpu.description: Default CPU limit. Set to empty string to omit.

memory.description: Default memory limit. Set to empty string to omit.

defaultRequests.description: Default resource requests applied to all containers in the namespace

priorityClassName.description: Pod priority class for vault-injector pods. If empty, defaults to vmware-system-important on Kubernetes >= 1.34, otherwise no priority class is set.

replicas.description: Number of replicas for vault-injector deployment

resources.description: Resource limits and requests for vault-injector containers
